actionId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

blockers.description: Typed blockers; empty iff status is actionable.

reasonCode.description: Stable machine-readable blocker code (open vocabulary; e.g. `authorization-denied`, `evidence-gap`, `capability-blocked`, `provider-unavailable`, `offline-queued`).

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

kind.description: Action kind (open vocabulary; advisory well-known values: open-project, select-task, inspect-evidence, capture-evidence, submit-evidence, inspect-boq-item, inspect-case, inspect-intervention, compare-outcome, measure-reference, answer-question, escalate, await-authorization, retry-sync).

prompt.description: The next-action prompt — for blocked actions, the explanation the user must see.

status.description: actionable (the prompt is a usable next action) | blocked (the blockers explain why no useful action is currently possible).
